evidence: Walked every scored criterion (2 gates, 46 functional, 5 polish, 5 visual) against the frozen golden bytes. Each has a plausible implementation path; none quotes a seeded figure the golden cannot produce. Key checks: (1) Seeded figures: seed reads give Lena (USR-CAN3/APP-301 read_count 2 of 3, last message by staff) exactly 1 unread, matching protocol Z and hro_unread_counts; APP-101 (Noor Platform Engineer) has 120 messages, golden pages 30 at a time (index.js:397-403, earlier_count 90/60/30) matching hro_thread_latest/earlier and app_context. Seed file is byte-identical to environment/assets/seed_data.json. (2) Move rules: one-stage check index.js:253; Hired reject refused :249; reopen only to rejected_from :252, reason cleared on reopen :312-314; blank reason :250; Interview places counted for the whole set :290-295, reorder in full Interview allowed because entering=0; whole move in one .immediate() transaction so refused bulk moves change nothing and add no activity. (3) Stale: version check :241-244 returns 409 with the last activity detail, e.g. '(Mei Lin moved F from Screen to Applied)', so the refusal names who (hro_stale_refused). (4) Bulk order: rank by STAGES index then position :284-288 gives Y,W,X after Y moved up and A2,V for mixed stages (hro_bulk_move step 4/13). (5) Undo: version_after equality :354 (notes do not bump version, so A2-with-note undo proceeds; Mei moving X blocks the V+X undo), Interview overfill check :357-359 (hro_undo_full in L), undone flag + latest-action-only :350-351 (hro_undo_once incl. Z staying), index-ordered reinsertion :363 restores Y,W,X,Z,A2 and V to top of Applied; reject_reason/rejected_from restored :365 (hro_reopen undo). (6) Roles: hiring-manager limits :257-264 (Interview/Offer/Hired, own job, reject from Interview/Offer, reopen), observer/candidate refused in mayMove :326-333 (candidate other app 404), anonymous 401 via auth() on every API route incl. bootstrap/events/messages/notes; open-job/add-candidate restricted to recruiter; notes restricted :380-382. (7) Candidate privacy: separate candidate read model :171-176 (id, job_title, team, status label, thread summary only); card detail/notes auth(...STAFF); other app conversation 404 :127; SSE carries no data :50. (8) Client: non-drag select+Move and Up/Down controls (board.js:208-241); optimistic move with snapshot put-back and focus on the card's select (board.js:181-205, fail():166-171) for hro_refused_put_back; email fault at field with name kept (board.js:52-55); rejected-from + reason in card and detail (board.js:131,255); activity newest-first with per-job filter (app.js:45-85; server ORDER BY id DESC); live SSE->debounced refresh with keyed in-place patching that preserves detail/note/focus/scroll (app.js:130-157, board.js:321-341); threads append-only with scroll-anchored earlier load (threads.js:160-175), scrolled-up pending notice without markRead (threads.js:145-159), seen receipts (index.js:143-150, threads.js:76-83, observer excluded), per-user localStorage drafts for replies and notes (app.js:39-43), 401->sessionLost sign-in prompt with drafts retained and isolated from Mei (app.js:34,189-195), failed fetch -> 'Not sent' with box kept (app.js:31, threads.js:194). (9) Restart: seedIfEmpty only when users table empty (db.js:124-125); solve.sh removes DB only at install. (10) Gates: wrong password 401 and stays on login; UI job+candidate creation shared via SQLite. (11) Visual likert: golden board.png shows a coherent finished desktop board; plausibly scores high. Measured support: scripted golden run (raw-evidence-index; hashes verified against frozen bytes) reports 20/20 groups passed incl. stale refusal naming the mover, bulk/undo through the page, live board arrival 801 ms with draft/focus kept, paging 30 with place kept, drafts/session resume/isolation, restart without reseed, no page errors. board.png shows empty name field after a duplicate-email refusal, but workspace.cjs:246-247 asserts the name was kept ('Ana Again') and then deliberately clears both fields before the screenshot, so this is not a defect. Residual latent observations (no failing criterion shown, recorded for the owner): (a) Undo activity lines read 'Rafael Costa undid a move: V is back in Applied' (index.js:366), naming who and the destination stage only; hro_activity requires lines 'naming who and the stages' — plausibly satisfied but a strict judge could want the from-stage. (b) Activity view shows 50 rows then a visible 'Show more (N earlier)' button (app.js:46,79-83); this review's protocol likely creates >50 lines across J1+J2, so the judge must click it; discoverable, not a hidden requirement. (c) In U, when Tomas's third message arrives with the conversation open at newest, the nav total badge transiently includes +1 for roughly one debounce+fetch cycle (render sets nav badges before catchUp->markRead; cleared by the refresh triggered by POST /read); protocol reads at or after 15 s, so practically invisible. (d) hro_pol_failed_send (abort one send) and hro_job_open values 0/51/2.5 were not scripted; source shows fetch rejection -> status 0 -> 'Not sent.' with text kept, and non-integer places rejected server-side (index.js:207; UI sends NaN->null). Counterexample probes: a conforming alternative whose undo line names only the destination (as the golden does) could be marked down by a literal judge on (a); a broken app that refuses stale moves without naming the mover would correctly fail hro_stale_refused. Risk=true because no full configured judge run, Oracle grade or judge-duration measurement exists (raw-evidence-index scope states these are absent); scripted golden observations are not judge evidence, so 'oracle can score high' remains plausible-by-source, not measured.
